title: ANXA1 (Annexin A1) regulated by MYC (MYC proto-oncogene) promotes the growth of papillary thyroid carcinoma.
authors: Ying, Xiaomei; Chen, Liang; Xie, Jiaheng; Hu, Yiming; Wu, Qingqing; Cao, Liyu; Yu, Hongzhu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MYC转录因子对ANXA1的调控及其在甲状腺癌增殖中的作用，但仅涉及表达关联和湿实验验证，无AI或物理模拟方法，也未进行蛋白-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Thyroid carcinoma is one of the most common endocrine malignancies, in which papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) is the main pathotype. ANXA1 plays a significant role in many cancer types, but how it works in PTC has not been identified. MYC is a common transcript factor involved in tumorigenesis, development, invasion, and metastasis. The relation between ANXA1 and MYC has not been proved in PTC. In this study, firstly, we analyzed the expression and prognostic value of ANXA1 in pan-cancer using the data from the UCSC database. Then we explore the role of ANXA1 in PTC, including expression, prognostic value, and immune infiltration. In addition, we evaluated the relation between ANXA1 and the transcription factor MYC. Finally, we identified the expression of ANXA1 and MYC and then evaluated their function associated with proliferation and apoptosis in PTC cell lines by CCK8 proliferation and flow cytometry apoptosis experiment. We found that ANXA1 is up-regulated in PTC comparing with normal patients. High expression of ANXA1 was associated with adverse overall survival of PTC. ANXA1 may be regulated by MYC to promote the proliferation of PTC. MYC may regulate the expression of ANXA and thus affect the proliferation of PTC.
abstract_zh: 甲状腺癌是最常见的内分泌恶性肿瘤之一，其中乳头状甲状腺癌（papillary thyroid carcinoma, PTC）是主要病理类型。ANXA1在多种癌症类型中发挥重要作用，但其在PTC中的作用机制尚未明确。MYC是一种常见的转录因子，参与肿瘤发生、发展、侵袭和转移。在PTC中，ANXA1与MYC之间的关系尚未得到证实。在本研究中，我们首先利用UCSC数据库的数据分析了ANXA1在泛癌中的表达及预后价值。随后，我们探讨了ANXA1在PTC中的作用，包括其表达、预后价值及免疫浸润情况。此外，我们评估了ANXA1与转录因子MYC之间的关系。最后，我们通过CCK8增殖实验和流式细胞术凋亡实验，鉴定了ANXA1和MYC在PTC细胞系中的表达，并评估了它们与增殖和凋亡相关的功能。我们发现，与正常患者相比，ANXA1在PTC中表达上调。ANXA1的高表达与PTC的不良总生存期相关。ANXA1可能受MYC调控，从而促进PTC的增殖。MYC可能通过调控ANXA的表达，进而影响PTC的增殖。
